title: Life uses 4 DNA letters. Scientists just made 8 work

The finding brings scientists closer to building expanded genetic systems that could perform entirely new biological functions.

title: A longer exhale may push your brain toward bolder decisions

title: Dark matter detector finds a strange signal scientists can’t yet explain

title: Scientists reveal the hidden instructions that build the human brain
summary: UCLA researchers have discovered two powerful influences that help guide how the human brain forms before birth. Those signals can alter which types of neurons are produced, including upper-layer neurons that are especially prominent in humans.
